description:
Fixtures that should emit (or fail on) a non-exhaustiveness diagnostic no longer do. Regression of the closed fz-rh2.11.8 (emit type/no-matching-clause for partial case/with). Verified pre-existing vs parent commit ca703c6b7 — independent of the fz-vn5 cons-reuse arc.

Fixtures / signals (fixtures2/behavior):
- spec_violation (run/interp/build): matrix reports 'expected diagnostic (nonzero exit) but the program succeeded' — fz2 exits 0 where it must halt.
- tree: lost its 'warning[type/no-matching-clause]: fn clauses don't cover every input' (the inc_tree tuple clause). Golden tree.expected.diagnostics still holds the warning.
- case_tuple_pattern_sequential: lost its 'case_clause' fall-through diagnostics.

Recover the exhaustiveness/clause-coverage diagnostics across fn clauses and case/with so these fixtures fail (spec_violation) or warn (tree, case_tuple) as their goldens require. References: closed fz-rh2.11.8; golden disposition tracked in fz-rh2.16.2.
title: [BUG] Compiler2 lost exhaustiveness/spec diagnostics regressed
